headline: Approved September minutes; discussed new high school drainage, athletic field outbuildings and an apprenticeship program.
summary: Building Futures described its Registered Apprenticeship program and how it works with school projects. Officials gave a construction update on the new high school, including a drainage plan with 57 catch basins. The chair said there are not currently funds for athletic field outbuildings, which were estimated to cost less than $1.6 million under the bleachers.
decisions: Approved the September 24, 2026 meeting minutes unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: A. September 24, 2026 Motion to approve: Kimberly Grant Second: Hersh Cristino Yea: all Motion carries unanimously.
